name: When I Fly Towards You
description: Set off by a sweet chance encounter, 16-year-old Su Zaizai finds herself helplessly drawn to Zhang Lurang — her smart, charming yet distant schoolmate.

videos.title: Lost Rainy Days, I Long to Be Soaked Once More
videos.overview: On the first day at Su Zaizai's high school, a rainy encounter between her and a charming schoolmate leads to a romantic mistake.

videos.title: I Like It When You Frown and Call Me Coward
videos.overview: An accident causes Zaizai to cross paths with Zhang Lurang again, but a series of snafus lead her to continue mistaking Lurang for someone else.

videos.title: Can You Come a Bit Closer?
videos.overview: Hoping to be closer to her crush, Zaizai persuades a friend to get Lurang to join the Drama Club. Later, she confronts inappropriate behavior on a bus.

videos.title: When We Started Getting Closer.
videos.overview: Zaizai's English paper earns her recognition across the school — as well as an opportunity to tutor Lurang, who's struggling with the subject.

videos.title: Those Moments I Have Never Regretted
videos.overview: After a triumphant basketball game, Jiang Jia develops a crush on one of the players. Soon after, Zaizai is blamed for conducting an unseemly act.

videos.title: When Susu Meets Susu
videos.overview: Zaizai and Lurang continue to help each other with their grades. As the school's field day draws near, an injury abruptly leaves Zaizai out of the games.

videos.title: Good Job, I'll Reward You With Ten Points
videos.overview: Lurang and Zaizai showcase great improvement in their studies. Later at the Drama Club, Lurang agrees to help Zaizai with her lines — on one condition.

videos.title: Hey, My Prince
videos.overview: Due to an accident, Lurang replaces Shen Qianyu as the lead in the school's drama. Facing some bullies, Jiang Jia steps up to protect Gu Ran.

videos.title: You Are More Charming Than the Scenery
videos.overview: An aquarium trip deepens the bond between Lurang and Zaizai. Meanwhile, with an academic contest on the horizon, a rumor spreads across the campus.

videos.title: On Doomsday, I Want to Tell You That...
videos.overview: Zaizai documents an unforgettable train ride on a special night. Later, Guan Fang reveals a different side of himself with his act of courage.

videos.title: Happy New Year, Rangrang
videos.overview: Hoping to see her crush, Zaizai agrees to a family trip. But shortly after arriving in Suyang, she encounters Lurang in an awkward situation.

videos.title: If Only Heroes Could Be Normal
videos.overview: After an awkward reunion, Jiang Jia takes care of Gu Ran when he falls ill. Later, Lurang comforts Gu Ran about his parents' demanding job.

videos.title: A Fluttering Feeling I Can't Ignore
videos.overview: As Qianyu prepares to study abroad, a love letter sparks a series of misunderstandings. Jiang Jia's attitude towards Gu Ran leaves him disheartened.

videos.title: So Rangrang Likes Sunflowers
videos.overview: Jiang Jia musters the courage to confess her feelings to Qianyu. To fund their trip to a music festival, the friends take on a part-time gig.

videos.title: Something That Only I Don't Know About
videos.overview: After summer break, the students enter a new phase of their high school journey. The closeness between Lurang and Zaizai lands them in hot water.

videos.title: A Mutual Idol
videos.overview: Zaizai confronts Lurang about why he's hiding an important piece of news from her. Zhang Luli, the famous prodigy sibling of Lurang, arrives in Yongan.

videos.title: My Wish When I Was 17 Was About You
videos.overview: Zaizai gets a delightful birthday surprise as well as a thoughtful gift. As the college entrance exam nears, and Jiang Jia struggles to pick a major.

videos.title: We're All Grown Up Now
videos.overview: Jiang Jia stumbles upon a new calling while Zaizai visits Lurang's school. An emergency after the graduation ceremony suddenly leaves everyone worried.

videos.title: Go and See a Brighter Light
videos.overview: Zaizai tries to confess her feelings to Lurang, but things don't go as planned. A romantic camping trip is almost spoiled by an oblivious Gu Ran.

videos.title: Copy and Paste, I've Learned It
videos.overview: Fresh into college life, Zaizai makes a playful bet with her roommate about Lurang. Meanwhile, a fresh face at school makes Lurang feel threatened.

videos.title: From Now on, Someone Will Share Your Happiness
videos.overview: Zaizai notices Xie Linnan's interest in her and informs him that she already has a boyfriend. Meanwhile, a pursuer of Lurang makes a series of moves.

videos.title: I Have Someone Who Listens to My Problems
videos.overview: Zaizai and Lurang embark on the next phase of their post-college lives. While Gu Ran prepares to return from abroad, Jiang Jia is swamped at work.

videos.title: You Have Always Been My Favorite
videos.overview: Lurang rushes to Zaizai's side after a distressing incident. Gu Ran faces a number of obstacles as he tries to express his feelings to Jiang Jia.

videos.title: When I Fly Towards You
videos.overview: In a heartfelt moment, Lurang poses a significant question to Zaizai. On their wedding day, they reflect on their beautiful journey together.
